title: Stockage
description: Storage of this computer: fill level of each volume (used, free, size, with warning at 85 % and critical at 95 %), live disk activity (read / write, MiB/s), physical disks (model, type and bus, size, partition table GPT/MBR, SMART health, temperature, wear, power-on hours, serial number), detailed SMART data per disk (spare, data read and written, power cycles, unsafe shutdowns, media errors), partitions (size, file system, label, mount point, role, 1 MiB alignment), inode usage (Linux), storage pools, software RAID, Btrfs multi-device, LVM and ZFS with their state, TRIM status, volumes marked dirty (admin only), file system error counters, and storage errors from the system log over the last 7 days. Findings flag full volumes, failing or worn disks, media errors, misaligned partitions, full inodes, degraded RAID, TRIM off and dirty volumes.

functions.name: analyze_space
functions.title: Analyse de l'espace
functions.help: Cherche les plus gros dossiers et fichiers d'un dossier ou d'un volume, pour savoir ce qui prend la place. Tâche longue ; « Durée max. » arrête l'analyse au bout du temps choisi (résultat partiel). Rien n'est supprimé.
functions.description: Analyzes disk space under a folder of this computer: the largest subfolders one level down (cumulative size, file count, share) and the largest files anywhere below. Use it to find what fills a disk. Skips virtual and network file systems; stops at the timeout and says the result is partial. Can take tens of seconds on a large folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Dossier
parameters.description: Folder to analyze; default: the user's home folder (Linux) or the system drive (Windows).

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Dossiers et fichiers affichés (les plus gros)
parameters.description: Number of folders and files listed.

functions.name: get_reclaimable_space
functions.title: Espace récupérable
functions.help: Estime la place libérable par catégorie (fichiers temporaires, caches, corbeille, journaux, conteneurs…) sans rien supprimer. Le nettoyage se fait avec l'outil Nettoyage de la page Maintenance.
functions.description: Estimates the disk space that could be freed on this computer, by category, without deleting anything: temporary files, recycle bin, user cache, package cache, systemd journal, Docker images and build cache (Linux); temp folders, recycle bin, Windows Update cache, CBS logs, memory dumps, thumbnails and browser caches (Windows). Each row says how to free it.
